# Attribution, provenance and AI assistance

This contribution is prepared for Artus's Tintagel mathematics verification
campaign with substantial OpenAI Pro and Codex assistance. It is a research
draft under this repository's Apache-2.0 license.

OpenAI Pro supplied the tensor-E8 construction and its complete provider proof.
PROVIDER-PROOF.md preserves that text verbatim (SHA-256 recorded in SOURCE.json).
Codex recovered and independently audited its identities, prices and RAM proof,
then bound the depth-one positive-C provider to the existing exact-Fourier
compiler. A separate fresh Codex adversarial referee rederived the depth-one
operator and transfer and wrote the exact checker adapted here. These roles and
AI assistance are disclosed; the contribution is not credited solely to the
packaging agent or described as a human-only or formal proof.

The imported OpenAI exact-Fourier compiler, synchronized-sector traversal,
canonical-root/CRT/chirp all-length transfer and source explanations are retained
literally at the immutable pin in SOURCE.json. Their attribution and references
to Newton interpolation, displacement methods, Bennett/dirty replay, Good's
coprime factorization and Bluestein's chirp identity remain in the source files.
OpenAI's Apache-2.0 LICENSE is included. No original h=100 supplier rate or
synthesis theorem is imported as this provider's result.

Prior E8 and community framework credit includes Jacob Sussman's E8 unit,
phase-frame/cover and WHT/Fourier work; the Croc community contributors and their
notices; Chafik Boukhalfa's explicit programs and exact-DFT transfer package;
eumemic's batched recursion and transfer; Ryan Shea's community-transfer idea
and independent audit; and the P390/P401/paired-cube antecedents described in
the provider source. This package uses no contributor program as an executable
dependency. It does not claim to invent E8 geometry, dirty response compensation,
orthogonal covers, tensorization or cyclic transfer.

The originally preserved P390 provenance notice follows unchanged. It attributes
that historical word; its source claims are not automatically this draft's
claimed theorems or added savings. The new provider rebuilds and pays its own
larger helper core and private tableau. See NOVELTY.md for the exact overlap.

# Provenance and credits

This package retains upstream code, data, licenses and notices. The new contribution is the target-prefix recovery construction and explicit dirty preconditioning for heterogeneous helper endpoints, together with the changed composition and checks.

Direct sources in CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds:

- PR376: exact helper reuse and its reconstruction selections.
- PR377: compressed nine-stage complex E8 supplier, bank padding, Clifford/cover framework.
- PR378: the far-retimed complex word on which the new prefix construction operates.
- PR381: nine-stage unsplit bit assembly, inherited exact moment and outer inequality machinery.

Essential ancestry and directly used ideas include PR352's E8 local identity and original sources, PR363 and PR373's stage constructions, PR370's bit E8 supplier, PR375's unsplit degree-two halving, PR315's compiler/dirty response machinery, PR266's exact checkers, and PR234's geometry machinery. Their bundled authorship and licenses remain authoritative. PR365's coupled complex moves are part of the retiming lineage. PR371's rounding correction and PR379's signed-compensation discussion inform the explicit conditional scope.

PR382 is the frozen stronger benchmark that invalidated our initial composition-only novelty claim; PR383 is the subsequent low-read composition reviewed in the same sweep. Neither is presented as our new mechanism. See research-notes/PR-SWEEP.md for every new PR surveyed in this round.

All PR numbers refer to https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/<number>. No publication, push or external message is performed by the supplied scripts.
